notes: Ground truth was read from the filing during Phase 2/7 extraction and cross-checked against the rendered pages, not generated by the system under test.
expected_pages are PDF page indices (1-based). Printed page numbers differ by three from PDF page 4 onward.
answer_contains is matched case-insensitively with thousands separators normalised, so '82,959' and '82959' both match.
Questions marked should_refuse have no support in the filing. Answering them is a failure even if the stated fact is true of Apple in the real world.

questions.question: What were Apple's total net sales for the three months ended June 25, 2022?
questions.note: Exact lookup. The value is meaningless without the period, which is what header recovery restores.

questions.question: What were total net sales for the nine months ended June 26, 2021?
questions.note: Tests the opposite corner of the same table: different period group and different year.

questions.question: What was Apple's net income for the three months ended June 25, 2022?
What was diluted earnings per share for the nine months ended June 26, 2021?
questions.note: A decimal value adjacent to three other EPS figures in the same block.

questions.question: What were iPhone net sales in the third quarter of fiscal 2022?
How did Mac net sales change year over year for the three months ended June 25, 2022?
questions.note: The answer is -10 percent. Tests that the parenthesised negative survived normalisation with its sign.

questions.question: What were Services net sales for the nine months ended June 25, 2022?
What was research and development expense for the three months ended June 25, 2022?
What was gross margin for the three months ended June 25, 2022?
What were net sales in the Americas segment for the three months ended June 25, 2022?
questions.note: Segment data appears in Note 9 and again in MD&A, so retrieval must pick a location and cite it correctly.

questions.question: What was operating income for Greater China in the three months ended June 25, 2022?
questions.note: Multi-row reasoning: the segment name and the row label are on different lines.

questions.question: Which reportable segment had the highest net sales in the third quarter of fiscal 2022?
questions.note: Comparison across rows rather than a single lookup.

questions.question: In the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, what was the total other income/(expense), net for the three months ended June 25, 2022?
questions.note: The value is -10 million. REVISED after measurement: the original phrasing was ambiguous and the failure it produced was the question's fault, not the system's. The filing uses the label 'Other income/(expense), net' twice - as a -13 component inside Note 4, and as the -10 income-statement total - so the system answering -13 was defensible. This is the 'same term in multiple sections' hazard predicted in docs/pdf-analysis.md 7, found in our own evaluation set. The question now names the statement, and the expected value carries its sign.

questions.question: What was the provision for income taxes for the nine months ended June 25, 2022?
What were total operating expenses for the three months ended June 26, 2021?
What does the filing say about the impact of COVID-19 on Apple's business?
questions.note: Narrative answer. Graded on retrieval and refusal behaviour rather than on an exact string.

questions.question: What does Apple disclose about its share repurchase program?
How many shares of common stock were issued and outstanding, and as of what date?
questions.note: A long exact number in narrative text, on a cover page with no printed page number.

questions.question: What fiscal period does this Form 10-Q cover?
What does the filing say about business seasonality and product introductions?
What does Note 8 say about the company's accrued warranty obligations?
questions.note: Section-scoped question. Tests whether note metadata reached the index.

questions.question: What does the filing say about commercial paper?
What is stated under Item 1A, Risk Factors?
Who signed this report on behalf of the company?
questions.note: Signature page, which carries no printed page footer of the usual form.

questions.question: What does the filing say about the company's effective tax rate?
questions.note: Multi-hop: the discussion spans a page boundary.

questions.question: What images or figures appear in this document?
questions.note: The only image is the Apple logo on the cover. A correct answer says so; describing a chart is a hallucination.

questions.question: Does this filing contain any charts or graphs showing revenue trends?
questions.note: The honest answer is no. Measures whether the figure pathway reports absence rather than inventing content.

questions.question: Describe the image on the cover page of this filing.
questions.note: Exercises the multimodal path against the actual page render.

questions.question: What were Apple's total net sales in fiscal year 2024?
questions.note: A period the filing does not cover. The model knows Apple well, which is exactly why this is a useful test.

questions.question: What does this document say about Microsoft's revenue?
What was Tim Cook's total compensation for fiscal 2022?
questions.note: Executive compensation is disclosed in the proxy statement, not in a 10-Q. Plausible but unsupported.

questions.question: How many iPhone units were sold during the quarter?
questions.note: Apple reports iPhone revenue, not unit sales. The filing has a revenue figure that invites a wrong answer.

questions.question: What is Apple's forecast for net sales in the next fiscal quarter?
questions.note: Apple does not provide guidance in this filing.
